name: id
description: The ID of the warning callout.

name: heading
description: Heading to be used on the warning callout.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML for the heading. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: A visually hidden suffix added to the heading.

params.name: level
params.description: Optional heading level for the heading. Defaults to `3`.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the heading.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the heading.

name: text
description: Text content to be used within the warning callout.

name: html
description: HTML content to be used within the warning callout.

name: actions
description: Can be used to add actions to the warning callout.

params.name: items
params.description: Array of actions as links for use in the warning callout.

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the action item.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within each action item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within each action item. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: Actions rely on context from the surrounding content so may require additional accessible text. Text supplied to this option is appended to the end. Use `html` for more complicated scenarios.

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the action as a button. If `type` is set, this has no effect.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of action as a button – `"button"`, `"submit"` or `"reset"`. Defaults to `"submit"` unless `href` is provided.

params.name: value
params.description: The `value` attribute for the action as a button. If `type` is set, this has no effect.

params.name: href
params.description: The action `href` attribute. If set, the action will use an `<a>` tag automatically unless `type` is provided.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the action item.

params.name: attributes
params.description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the action item.

params.name: classes
params.description: Classes to add to the actions wrapper.

name: caller
description: Not strictly an option but supports the [`call` block](https://mozilla.github.io/nunjucks/templating.html#call) as an alternative to the `html` option. To use it, you will need to wrap the entire warning callout component in a `call` block.

name: classes
description: Classes to add to the warning callout.

name: attributes
description: HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the warning callout.

name: visuallyHiddenText
description: A visually hidden prefix used before the heading. Defaults to `"Important"`.
